An Awesome Expat Bar Right in the Coolest Part District 1
May 2017 • Solo
I'm a digital nomad and travel the world with my computer. One of my great pleasures is to hook up with like minded expats wherever I go and have a beer and a chat. In HMC, the Orient bar is my "go-to" bar. Everyone that I have met so far seem really cool and friendly, including the owner Grant, an Australian who makes you feel right at home. They have a great beer, wine and booze selection - at very reasonable prices, great western food and amazing service. The team of vietnamese waitresses speak perfect english and are as pretty as they are gracious. Free internet, lots of large screen TV's plus an impressive sound system. A few days ago we watched three different premier league games at the same time which was exciting. As a relative newcomer to HCM, I am excited to have found the Orient bar - a cozy, friendly expat home-away-from-home.
